[[Assassin Insignia]] }} Advanced training for [[Cantha]]ns. Teaches how to [[snare (tactic)|snare]], and thus indirectly also teaches [[Kite|kiting]]. == Quest information == === Requirements === {{Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | active = Any [[insignia quest]] }} * You must have [[Warrior]], [[Ranger]], [[Elementalist]] or [[Assassin]] as your primary or secondary [[profession]]. === Objectives === * Speak with [[Kai Ying]] * Speak with Kai Ying again to begin your test. * Use [[snaring]] and [[kiting]] to force [[Zho]] into submission. * Speak with Kai Ying again. * See [[Instructor Ng]] for your reward === Early benefits === Skills provided: * {{w}} {{skill icon|Sprint}} * {{r}} {{skill icon|Pin Down}} * {{e}} {{skill icon|Deep Freeze}} * {{a}} {{skill icon|Caltrops}} === Reward === * 500 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] == Walkthrough == You will have been provided with skill that allows you to slow down an enemy (Warriors will receive a skill to [[Speed boost|run faster]]). Use these to hunt down and defeat Zho. * A Ritualist or Ranger can [[body block]] the center of the gate with 2 spirits to prevent Zho from leaving. This allows one to defeat Zho with ease. == NPCs == * {{E}} 10 (20) [[Kai Ying]] * {{R}} 10 (20) [[Zho]] == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Instructor Ng '' it is time that you learned the arts of snaring and kiting. Snaring lets you slow your foe's movement. Kiting is the act of using movement to make yourself a difficult target while attacking your foe mercilessly. Zho, one of our Ranger instructors, will assist us with this exercise. Slow her down and inflict enough damage upon her that she submits to your skill. Are you ready?'' ''By accepting this quest you will abandon other advance training quests and put yourself into a separate training arena from the rest of your party, if applicable.'' {{Offer dialog | accept = Show me the way to the dojo! | decline = Perhaps another time. | ask = Impeding your opponents' movements is a pivotal tactic. You would be wise to learn this. }} === Intermediate dialogue === ;Kai Ying ''Welcome to the Snaring course. Instructor Zho will be using a method called kiting to try to prevent you from inflicting damage upon her. Use your Snare skill to slow her down and attack her until she submits.'' ;Kai Ying ''Ready...begin!'' ;Kai Ying ''Very good. With an understanding of how to Snare foes, you will be better able to keep them from eluding your attacks."'' === Reward dialogue === ;Instructor Ng ''Well done. You have completed the Snaring Course. There is still plenty to learn, but you are fast becoming a valuable asset to any team.'' ==Notes== * Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are [[Weh no Su]]. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.
